cutoff.meaning: The end of the council's regular session on 8 September 2026, by which time the vote on Ordinance 2026-14 must have occurred.

negative_condition: The ordinance receives fewer than three affirmative votes (including a tie or failure) at the 8 September session, or is not voted on at that session.
positive_condition: The ordinance receives at least three affirmative votes at the 8 September session.

proof.meaning: The official minutes or vote tally from the 8 September session showing each member's vote on Ordinance 2026-14.
proof.name: Council vote record
proof.subject: Ordinance 2026-14

terminal_meaning: The question resolves when the Ellsworth Falls Village Council votes on Ordinance 2026-14 at its 8 September 2026 regular session, and the outcome is determined by whether at least three members vote in favor.
